LanguageData.LiAIChat_BlightfallArrivalText: A new pollution source has appeared at a moderate distance from your base. {0} additional tiles around its center are polluted. On the world map, yellow marks the frontline, red the contaminated interior, purple the core, and green purified territory.
LanguageData.LiAIChat_BlightfallDebugTriggered: The Blightfall arrival was triggered manually.
LanguageData.LiAIChat_BlightfallDebugUnavailable: The arrival cannot be triggered in this save: the campaign has already started, there is no player base, or no suitable nearby tile is available.
LanguageData.LiAIChat_BlightfallInteriorLocked: This tile is behind the frontline. Clear a frontline connected to safe territory before claiming it.
LanguageData.LiAIChat_BlightfallCoreLocked: The contamination core is still sealed. Purify all other contaminated tiles first.
LanguageData.LiAIChat_BlightfallCoreProtected: Resonance spires still shield the core. Destroy all of them before purifying the core.
LanguageData.LiAIChat_BlightfallCoreProtectedAndSeale: The outer contamination remains, and resonance spires still shield the core. Advance the frontline and destroy all of them first.
LanguageData.LiAIChat_BlightfallResonanceNetworkStatu: Blightfall core defense network: resonance spires remaining {0}/{1}
LanguageData.LiAIChat_BlightfallEndingDestroyDesc: Destroy the source permanently. Spread and hostile activity stop, but the core tile remains polluted and must be cleaned later.
LanguageData.LiAIChat_BlightfallEndingPurifyDesc: Requires Fabrication research. Rewrite the source to stop hostile activity and let it purify one connected polluted tile every five days.
LanguageData.LiAIChat_BlightfallEndingHarnessDesc: Control the source. It will no longer spread without limit, but needs 50 Chemfuel every five days. Successful maintenance supplies 10 Uranium; every two failures risk an instability attack.
LanguageData.LiAIChat_BlightfallEndingDestroyText: The source is destroyed. Contamination spread and Blightfall attacks have permanently stopped. Pollution and wastepacks remain at the core site; return there to complete the existing waste dump cleanup task.
LanguageData.LiAIChat_BlightfallEndingPurifyText: Fabrication technology has rewritten the source. Hostile activity has ended, and the Heart will gradually purify connected polluted world tiles every five days.
LanguageData.LiAIChat_BlightfallEndingHarnessTitle: The Blight Heart is under control
LanguageData.LiAIChat_BlightfallEndingHarnessText: The source is contained and no longer spreads freely. Every five days it consumes 50 Chemfuel to produce 10 Uranium. If maintenance fails twice in a row, the Heart may trigger an instability attack.
LanguageData.LiAIChat_BlightfallHarnessMaintainedText: The controlled Heart consumed {0} Chemfuel and produced {1} Uranium.
LanguageData.LiAIChat_BlightfallHarnessFailureText: The controlled Heart could not consume {0} Chemfuel. Consecutive failures: {1}. Every second failure may cause an instability attack.
LanguageData.LiAIChat_BlightfallHarnessIncursionText: A maintenance failure destabilized the controlled Heart. A small Blight force is attacking the colony.
LanguageData.LiAIChat_BlightfallPurificationWaveText: The purified Heart has cleansed one connected contaminated world tile. Its former site has been removed from the world map.
LanguageData.Blightfall_ResponseLetterText: The settlement of {1}, belonging to {0}, attempted {2}. {3}
LanguageData.Blightfall_ResponseMilitary: send an expedition against a pollution node
LanguageData.Blightfall_ResponseSuccess: The action succeeded and slowed pollution.
LanguageData.Blightfall_ResponseFailure: The action failed and pollution activity increased.
LanguageData.LiAIChat_BlightfallRequestJointExpeditio: Request an allied joint purification expedition
LanguageData.LiAIChat_BlightfallJointExpeditionGizmoD: Choose an allied settlement to send fighters to the current contaminated site. Each site accepts one request.
LanguageData.LiAIChat_BlightfallNoAlliedExpeditionSou: No allied settlement is available to respond
LanguageData.LiAIChat_BlightfallExpeditionAlreadyRequ: A joint expedition has already been requested for this contaminated site.
LanguageData.LiAIChat_BlightfallExpeditionUnavailable: Support cannot be requested for this contaminated site right now.
LanguageData.LiAIChat_BlightfallExpeditionFailed: The allied expedition could not arrive. This site's support request is consumed.
